subject: dxf: calculate max_node_count and concurrency for next-gen automatically (#62995)
summary: Reviewed this commit (vs first parent) focusing on DDL/add-index DXF autoscaling and related metadata paths. Changes refactor reorg meta initialization into `pkg/ddl/reorg_util.go`, add next-gen auto calculation of reorg `Concurrency` and DXF `MaxNodeCount` from table size + exec-node CPU (with new scheduler autoscaler helpers and node CPU lookup by role). No remaining High/Blocker issues found in correctness, data consistency, compatibility, concurrency limits, or metadata/state-machine handling after checking downstream usage and later upstream history.
